render_healthcheck.purpose: cheap liveness only; does not call Supabase or OpenAI

deep_health.purpose: readiness check for Supabase and OpenAI; intended for external monitors, not platform restart healthchecks

profile.purpose: profile plus deletion_status so mobile can show restore gate

profile.note: plan is owned by RevenueCat and is not user-updatable; rejected while account deletion is pending

profile.purpose: restore account during the 7-day deletion grace period
schedule account deletion with 7-day restore window; data is purged later by /internal/accounts/purge-deleted

scans.purpose: SSE scan progress with keep-alive heartbeats
paginated scan list via list_scans_with_activity RPC
total and per-category counts for filter chips
signed file URLs; can render PDF previews
bulk delete scans/messages/deadlines without resetting usage quota
delete one scan; cascades messages and linked deadlines

limits.purpose: also returns chat usage for that scan

status.purpose: OAMP/IPC case status lookup through Playwright

internal.purpose: permanently purge accounts whose 7-day deletion grace period elapsed

scan_pipeline: sign image URLs or render PDFs to PNG data URLs with PyMuPDF
check plan quota after final page count is known
best-effort auto-deadlines and chat thread seed

streaming_scan.heartbeats: SSE comments every 10 seconds during blocking calls

chat.context: scan OCR/result, message history, and RAG snippets

oamp_status.implementation: Playwright Chromium in a worker thread
oamp_status.supported: proceedings fields / formatted OAM case number / visa application number (ŽOV)

help.content_model: categories and UI strings from YAML; published guides from Postgres help_guides

account_deletion.delete_profile: DELETE /profile now marks profiles.deletion_status=pending, sets deletion_requested_at/deletion_scheduled_at/deletion_reason, clears expo_push_token, and leaves user data intact for 7 days.
account_deletion.normal_api_guard: get_active_user_id blocks normal app endpoints with 403 detail.code=account_pending_deletion while pending. /profile and /profile/restore remain available.
account_deletion.restore: POST /profile/restore clears deletion fields and returns ProfileResponse.
account_deletion.final_purge: POST /internal/accounts/purge-deleted deletes due pending accounts after the grace period: RevenueCat subscriber best-effort, storage best-effort, push_tokens/deadlines/trackings/usage_limits/scans/profile rows, and Supabase Auth identity.

pro.usage_period: subscription period derived from RevenueCat expiration when available

important_constraints: usage_limits.month accepts YYYY-MM and pro:start:end subscription-period keys
bulk scan delete does not reset usage_limits after migration 0009
profiles.deletion_status accepts active/pending; profiles_pending_deletion_idx accelerates purge lookup by deletion_scheduled_at

infrastructure.title: Set or confirm GitHub repo variables for Render
infrastructure.details: If the Render hostname changes, set RENDER_STAGING_URL and UPTIME_URL in GitHub repo variables.

infrastructure.title: Remove old Railway secrets from GitHub
infrastructure.details: RAILWAY_TOKEN_STAGING and RAILWAY_TOKEN_PRODUCTION are no longer used by workflows.

infrastructure.title: Create separate production Render service
infrastructure.details: Then enable verify-production in .github/workflows/ci.yml and set RENDER_PRODUCTION_URL.

infrastructure.title: Branch protection on main
infrastructure.details: Require PR and successful CI before merge.

infrastructure.title: Custom SMTP in Supabase
infrastructure.details: Replace Supabase built-in SMTP before public signups.

infrastructure.title: Sentry or equivalent error tracking
infrastructure.details: Attach request_id from middleware to backend error events.

backend_features.title: Complete production RAG content outside cizinecka/OAMP
backend_features.details: Need stronger curated knowledge for danove, ucty, socialni, zdravotni, smlouvy, soudni, urad_prace, and skolstvi.

backend_features.title: Push notification scheduler for deadlines
backend_features.details: Cron/background job to send Expo push notifications based on active deadlines and reminder_days.

backend_features.title: Generated response drafts
backend_features.details: Endpoint such as POST /scans/{id}/draft-response for odvolani/zadost templates.

backend_features.title: Signed upload URL helper
backend_features.details: POST /scans/upload-urls for mobile parallel upload workflow.

backend_features.title: Schedule internal account purge cron
backend_features.details: Call POST /internal/accounts/purge-deleted with X-Cron-Secret on a daily/hourly schedule after deployment so due pending-deletion accounts are physically removed after the 7-day grace period.

mobile_and_monetization.title: Expo push token storage and foreground handling

known_issues.title: Render Free spin-down
known_issues.impact: First request after idle may be slow; not suitable for production SLA.
known_issues.fix: Move to paid Render/Cloud Run/VPS when continuous availability matters.

known_issues.title: RAG coverage is uneven outside immigration/OAMP
known_issues.impact: Analysis quality can be weaker for non-cizinecka categories.

known_issues.title: Supabase built-in SMTP is not launch-ready
known_issues.impact: Auth emails can hit low default SMTP limits.

known_issues.title: Production verification job is disabled
known_issues.impact: Only staging Render verification runs in CI.

known_issues.title: Account purge endpoint still needs external schedule
known_issues.impact: Pending-deletion accounts are blocked and restorable, but final physical deletion after 7 days depends on a cron/scheduler calling /internal/accounts/purge-deleted.
